parameters.description: A pointer to an RTL_OSVERSIONINFO- or RTL_OSVERSIONINFOEX-compatible structure that receives the current operating system version information.

return.success: Returns STATUS_SUCCESS on success. Other NTSTATUS values describe the failure.
return.failure: A non-success NTSTATUS value. Use RtlNtStatusToDosError or the documented status codes to interpret it.

apis.remarks: RtlGetVersion is the native equivalent of GetVersionEx. When using this routine to test for a required Windows version, compare version numbers as greater-than-or-equal rather than exact equality so later versions also satisfy the check. Because features can be delivered outside the base OS, major and minor version numbers alone are not a reliable feature test; use RtlVerifyVersionInfo when checking for specific system features.
